sql_text: SELECT ps_partkey, MAX(ps_supplycost) - MIN(ps_supplycost) AS cost_range, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING MAX(ps_supplycost) - MIN(ps_supplycost) > 100 ORDER BY cost_range DESC LIMIT 30;

SELECT ps_partkey, MAX(ps_supplycost) - MIN(ps_supplycost) AS cost_range, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_qty FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING MAX(ps_supplycost) - MIN(ps_supplycost) > 100 ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 30;
SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;

SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) >= 1994 GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;

SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) <= 1997 GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;
SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;
SELECT c_mktsegment, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;

SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;

SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_totalprice > 100000 GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY revenue DESC;
SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o_orderdate) AS qtr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment, qtr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, qtr;
SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, MAX(o_totalprice) AS max_order FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;

SELECT c_mktsegment, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_totalprice <= 100000 GROUP BY c_mktsegment, yr ORDER BY c_mktsegment, yr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_price FROM lineitem GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, MAX(l_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM lineitem GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount < 0.05 GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem WHERE l_discount >= 0.05 GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS qtr, AVG(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS avg_net_price FROM lineitem GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_commitdate) AS yr, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_commitdate) AS qtr, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem GROUP BY yr, qtr ORDER BY yr, qtr;
SELECT s_nationkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM supplier s WHERE s_acctbal < ( SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey ) ORDER BY s_nationkey, s_acctbal;
SELECT s_nationkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM supplier s WHERE s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) ORDER BY s_nationkey, s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT s_nationkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM supplier s WHERE s_acctbal < (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) AND s_acctbal > 0 ORDER BY s_nationkey, s_acctbal;
SELECT s_nationkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM supplier s WHERE s_acctbal < (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2) ORDER BY s_acctbal;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS below_avg_suppliers FROM supplier s WHERE s_acctbal < (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey);

SELECT n_name, COUNT(*) AS below_avg_count FROM nation JOIN supplier s ON n_nationkey = s_nationkey WHERE s_acctbal < (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY below_avg_count DESC;
SELECT s_nationkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM supplier s WHERE s_acctbal <= (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) ORDER BY s_nationkey, s_acctbal;
SELECT s_nationkey, AVG(s_acctbal) AS national_avg, MIN(s_acctbal) AS min_bal, MAX(s_acctbal) AS max_bal FROM supplier GROUP BY s_nationkey ORDER BY s_nationkey;
SELECT s_nationkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM supplier s WHERE s_acctbal < 0 ORDER BY s_nationkey, s_acctbal;
SELECT s_nationkey, s_name, s_acctbal, (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) AS national_avg FROM supplier s ORDER BY s_nationkey, s_acctbal;

SELECT r_name, COUNT(*) AS below_avg_count FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n_nationkey = s_nationkey WHERE s_acctbal < (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY below_avg_count DESC;
SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;

SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;

SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;
SELECT o_orderpriority, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;

SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
SELECT o_orderpriority, MAX(l_quantity) AS max_qty, MIN(l_quantity) AS min_qty FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;
SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;
SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, AVG(l_discount) AS avg_discount FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;

SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_totalprice > 100000 GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;

SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_totalprice <= 100000 GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;
SELECT o_shippriority, o_orderpriority, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_shippriority, o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;
SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey ORDER BY cost_stddev DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey ORDER BY cost_stddev ASC LIMIT 20;
SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING STDDEV(ps_supplycost) > 100 ORDER BY cost_stddev DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING STDDEV(ps_supplycost) <= 100 ORDER BY cost_stddev DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT ps_partkey, VARIANCE(ps_supplycost) AS cost_variance FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey ORDER BY cost_variance DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT p_brand, AVG(STDDEV_sub.cost_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM part JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey) STDDEV_sub ON p_partkey = STDDEV_sub.ps_partkey GROUP BY p_brand ORDER BY avg_stddev DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey ORDER BY cost_stddev DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey ORDER BY cost_stddev DESC LIMIT 30;
SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey ORDER BY cost_stddev DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_variance_parts FROM (SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey HAVING STDDEV(ps_supplycost) > 100) t;

SELECT p_type, AVG(s.cost_stddev) AS avg_stddev FROM part JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, STDDEV(ps_supplycost) AS cost_stddev FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey) s ON p_partkey = s.ps_partkey GROUP BY p_type ORDER BY avg_stddev DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN ( SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1993 ) AND c_custkey IN ( SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997 );

SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1994) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997);

SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1993) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1996);

SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1995) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loyal_customers FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1993) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997);

SELECT c_mktsegment, COUNT(*) AS loyal_count FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1993) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997) GROUP BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY loyal_count DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1993) AND c_custkey NOT IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997);

SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1993) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997) ORDER BY c_custkey;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1993) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997) ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC;

SELECT n_name, COUNT(*) AS loyal_count FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1993) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) = 1997) GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY loyal_count DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) BETWEEN 1993 AND 1995) AND c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) BETWEEN 1996 AND 1997);
SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_type, yr ORDER BY p_type, yr;

SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY p_type, yr ORDER BY p_type, yr;

SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p_type, yr ORDER BY p_type, yr;
SELECT p_type, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_type ORDER BY net_revenue DESC;
SELECT p_brand, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_brand, yr ORDER BY p_brand, yr;
SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, AVG(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS avg_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_type, yr ORDER BY p_type, yr;
SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_type, yr ORDER BY p_type, yr;

SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE l_discount < 0.05 GROUP BY p_type, yr ORDER BY p_type, yr;

SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey WHERE l_discount >= 0.05 GROUP BY p_type, yr ORDER BY net_revenue DESC;

SELECT p_container, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_container, yr ORDER BY p_container, yr;
SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS yr, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_type, yr ORDER BY p_type, yr;

SELECT n_name, AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN ( SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey ) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY avg_lines_per_order DESC;

SELECT n_name, AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY avg_lines_per_order ASC;

SELECT n_name, MAX(line_count) AS max_lines_per_order FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY max_lines_per_order DESC;

SELECT r_name, AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY avg_lines_per_order DESC;

SELECT n_name, AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY avg_lines_per_order DESC;

SELECT n_name, AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY avg_lines_per_order DESC;

SELECT c_mktsegment, AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY avg_lines_per_order DESC;

SELECT n_name, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY total_lines DESC;

SELECT n_name, AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY avg_lines_per_order DESC;

SELECT n_name, MIN(line_count) AS min_lines_per_order FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY min_lines_per_order;

SELECT n_name, AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) lc ON o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey WHERE o_totalprice > 100000 GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY avg_lines_per_order DESC;

SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice < AVG(ps_supplycost);

SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice > AVG(ps_supplycost);

SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice <= AVG(ps_supplycost);

SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_supply_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice < MIN(ps_supplycost);
SELECT COUNT(*) AS underwater_parts FROM (SELECT p_partkey FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice < AVG(ps_supplycost)) t;

SELECT p_type, COUNT(*) AS underwater_count FROM (SELECT p_partkey, p_type FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, p_type HAVING p_retailprice < AVG(ps_supplycost)) underwater GROUP BY p_type ORDER BY underwater_count DESC;

SELECT p_brand, COUNT(*) AS underwater_count FROM (SELECT p_partkey, p_brand FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_brand, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice < AVG(ps_supplycost)) underwater GROUP BY p_brand ORDER BY underwater_count DESC;

SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, (AVG(ps_supplycost) - p_retailprice) AS loss_margin FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice < AVG(ps_supplycost) ORDER BY loss_margin DESC;

SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, MAX(ps_supplycost) AS max_supply_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice < MAX(ps_supplycost) ORDER BY p_retailprice DESC;

SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part JOIN partsupp ON p_partkey = ps_partkey WHERE ps_availqty > 500 GROUP BY p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice HAVING p_retailprice < AVG(ps_supplycost);
